basis: Printed English clauses and existing creator rulings: handwritten costs, counters, destinations and timing assertions; no expected values read from ability metadata.

contracts.name: Unite Impulses
contracts.printedText: All manifestations currently in your Interzone gain Support until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Rally
contracts.printedText:
You may use extra {H} essences as tribute to play this Will.
For each extra essence used to play this Will, put a token with 1 power {H} into Support.

contracts.name: Mirror the Impulse
contracts.printedText: Put into Support a token copy of a target manifestation you control on the field.

contracts.name: Reforging Fate
contracts.printedText:
A target manifestation in a player's Limbo enters into Support under your control.
If that manifestation wins the confrontation, exile it.

contracts.name: Persist
contracts.printedText: A target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone gains Persist until the end of the turn. (If a manifestation with Persist has won the confrontation, it remains in the Confrontation Zone as First Manifestation).

contracts.name: Incinerate
contracts.printedText: Destroy all manifestations on the field that entered Support this turn.
